reviews.t: It's too soft and the two speed / speed of it I didn't like. It has two speed level but not strong ...
reviews.x: The brush is not strong enough to clean the pores on your face. It's too soft and the two speed / speed of it I didn't like. It has two speed level but not strong enough. All other connectors for facial massage are weak too and they dont feel anything on the face when used. You can use this on your body lol because it applies no pressure might as well stick to a wash cloth. Disappointed .. will be returning

Kind of disappointing.  I do use it sometimes, mainly because I have trouble reaching all parts of my back.  The motor is much weaker than I feel it needs to be.  Probably should have saved my money.  Not sure if there is another stronger brand out there.  I read reviews on many before I purchased, and they all sound the same.

reviews.t: I love the handle and the back brush!
reviews.x: I've been wanting to try one of these for a while and I'm glad I finally did! I couldn't believe how much dirt was still left on my skin after I just use my usual method of face wash and a washcloth. I followed up with this brush and let's just say I was impressed with the deep clean! I also like that it comes with a larger brush and a handle for your back. The only drawback is the instructions are so tiny you'll need a magnifying glass to read it.

reviews.t: I love mine. My only issue is the bristles seem ...
reviews.x: I love mine. My only issue is the bristles seem to be too soft on one of the heads. I’m hoping to find firmer replacement heads. I’m really thankful it’s waterproof as I use it in the shower and have had no problems. Definitely worth the money

I was really excited about getting this. I don't buy a whole lot of things just for "me." But when I got it, I was disappointed. It doesn't have much power to it, to be honest. I'd gotten something for my daughter prior to this and it's rechargeable instead of reloading batteries. Don't know if that makes any difference but hers has a lot more power to it.  I love the attachments, but there is no way the pumice attachments are going to do anything for the feet because any amount of pressure towa

It’s a fairly great idea with all the attachments and possibility, but four months down the line and a few past the return window it’s sputtering and failing or getting stuck in operation that it can’t be shut off. Bottom line, you’re wasting your money and will need to repurchase in a few months.
this product will do the job butt I only gave it 4 stars because it short on power so you need to have some patience to use butt you can reach all your back with it

reviews.x: I bought 3 of this one for my wife and one each for my sister in law they love it it's perfect Christmas gift... good product keep up the good quality...

reviews.t: Amazing product for this price point- I always used the ...
reviews.x: Amazing product for this price point- I always used the Olay version but decided to try a new brand- so pleased with this purchase.

reviews.t: Amazing, the replacement heads are even available on site!
reviews.x: I really like this brush. I‘m a bit of a skin care junkie and was waiting to use all three heads before I wrote a review, and I give it five stars all around. I was skeptical over the exfoliation brush and the everyday being the same, but they’re actually serving different purposes! The exfoliate is soft but does feel a bit firmer, so I feel it truly gets down into my pores when I do my treatments weekly. I enjoy the soft feel of the daily brush, and when I feel I want something a little more de

Love how this device is so versatile!! It’s completely waterproof and runs on only 2 AA batteries... It has a lot of brush head choices, and converts from a face brush to a body brush in under a minute by just switching the brush head and clipping the device into the extended handle. I love that it came with a handy storage case, the only downside I found to that was the case didn’t fit all the interchangeable pieces... Overrall however, that wasn’t a huge issue, it all worked great and came wit

There are other cheap ones that feel cheap.  My 10 month old  130 lb. Great Dane puppy also liked the way it felt....in his mouth.  Attached are photos. reviews.t: It's wonderful that it has all of the attachments
reviews.x: I bought this for my teenage son, who is concerned about acne. He has been faithfully using it for a week, and it seems to really be improving his skin! It's wonderful that it has all of the attachments, so it be used both for daily and for weekly deep exfoliation, and the pumice works great to smooth rough feet! It is super easy to change attachments, the instructions were easy to follow, and it's just an nice-looking appliance overall. I am planning to get one for myself and I think these will

reviews.t: it’s a good product. This is my first facial brush so ...
reviews.x: For the price, it’s a good product. This is my first facial brush so I don’t have much to compare to but, the speeds are great, the facial brush works wonderfully, the massage one feels so cheap and I don’t think it did much to my face😕 I love that it comes with an extender but in my opinion it made it more difficult to use on high speed. I tried all of them so far besides the silicone one as my face is never really dry, but they work pretty good. For my first facial brush I like it and I’ll con

This is a great little portable brush. I used it almost every day for a year. It has just started to wear down. I found the wide selection of heads a bit unnecessary. I only used the small and large brush. The case was a nice addition but i dont travel a lot. I upgraded this year to a rechargable model with less parts . I will keep this one as a face brush until it really goes caput. While this works for everyday use, i think it is better suited for travel .

I have been using this brush for about a year now. I use the silicone attachment daily, and use the bristly attachment when I've worn makeup. It gets my face so clean! I stopped getting frequent breakouts, and on the rare occasion I do, this bad boy clears it up before anything comes to a head. My skin tone is a lot more even now, too. This product has really worked wonders for me and the seller has great customer service, as well!

I love , love, love this set. I use it twice daily and I think the case is so convient. The only attachment I have an issue with is the sponge, its too stiff for any applications too easily the velcro detaches and the sponge goes flying. Every other attachments ia frequently used though. So well put together that i can still use the larger brush after dropping and chipping part of the attaching system.

I love this spin brush! The extender is amazing for getting those hard to reach areas and the dual speeds really help to target areas. Absolutely love the variety of  brush heads. Only thing I don't like is that the storage case does not hold all the pieces to this kit. This concerns me because I often need to take this with me to the gym and not being able to pack the kit safely worries me!

I've had this for a year and I will say it definitely gets really dirty.  Yes, it cleans well and is easy to use but soap scum sticks to it like crazy.  The power button definitely gets waterlogged.  Mine stopped working/basically started turning on by itself!  I had to take the batteries out of it completely.  Wish I could get a replacement one.

I bought this set and it stopped working within a few months! I was really happy with it until the motor stopped functioning. It kept turning on and off and eventually, it stopped working completely. I would recommend another brush. I tried reaching out to see if they could send me a new one but I didn't hear anything back from the company :/

I absolutely love this brush. I've checked a few options before choosing this one, however I am extremely pleased with this purchase. The brush heads are great size, work wonderfully well and my face and body feel really great afterwards. The handle is a great option for back scrub and the massage head is awesome for relieving stress.

I only used 2 of the brushes: the bristle and silicon one and they clean the face well. I wouldn't submerged the handle, I would wipe it when it would get wet and after less than a month it stopped turning on. I opened the battery area and there was no water in there. Smh I assume the motor stopped working.

reviews.t: It's a really good product at the fraction of the price of the ...
reviews.x: I honestly do't know what I was doing with skin care without this. It's a really good product at the fraction of the price of the expensive ones, which do the same thing this does. the bristles are soft and the different heads provides the full range of body care. I highly recommend.

A month in and I'm disappointed in this purchase. I use two main brushes for day and night skin care. After each use, I soak the brushes in warm, soapy water and let them air dry. I store the additional brushes in a plastic container (the ones I don't use as often, or rarely).

This product was amazing after I used it a few times. At first I went overboard and my face got red and looked like a sunburn. After my face got used to the brush and I didn’t use it every five minutes, it was just what I was looking for. I’m thinking about buying it again!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the motor or brush power too weak, especially for facial cleaning.
Reviewers appreciate the variety of attachments and versatility, including converting from face to body brush.
Several reviewers praise the value for the price and consider it a good alternative to name brands.
Some reviewers find the bristles or massage attachments too soft or cheap-feeling.
A few reviewers report durability problems, with the device failing or sputtering after a few months.
